feed.title: Open MPC - Plugin Catalog: new releases

entry.title: Tuner 1.1.2
entry.summary: A chromatic tuner insert with a live needle drawn straight onto the MPC's screen at 20-24 fps: note, cents and Hz, A4 from 430 to 450 Hz, and a mute for silent tuning. It writes into MPC's display memory, which MPC OS doesn't offer plugins, so a firmware update could break it. Not affiliated with Akai.

entry.title: Stompbox 1.1.2
entry.summary: A whole guitar rig from guitarix's DSP: gate, comp, wah, any number of pedals, amp, tone stack, power amp, cabinet with an IR loader, post FX, mod, delay, reverb and EQ. 219 models and guitarix's 40 factory presets in the PRESET menu. Not affiliated with guitarix.

entry.title: Open MPC Plugin Manager 1.3.0
entry.summary: The official OpenMPC plugin manager for Gen1 and Gen2 MPCs (32-bit build for Force, Live, One, X, Key; 64-bit for the Live III and kin). Browse this catalog and install, update and remove plugins on the MPC itself, with rollback if an install fails. Built on poloq's mpc-vst-manager.

entry.title: NodalRed2x 0.2.0
entry.summary: An emulation of the Clavia Nord Lead 2x's original firmware (gearmulator) as a native instrument for Gen2 MPC devices: a native MPC screen laid out like the Nord's panel, a starter bank plus your own sound sets, RANDOM, named favourites in the PRESET menu and Q-Link control. Gen2 (aarch64) only; you need your own Nord Lead 2x ROM.

entry.title: NAM 1.1.1
entry.summary: Neural Amp Modeler captures as an insert effect, with cab IR, tone, gate, pitch, delay, reverb and an on-device TONE3000 downloader.

entry.title: MPC Commander 1.3.2
entry.summary: The plugins MPC loads, with their own skins, and MPC's transport, on a desktop app. Listens on the device only: reach it through an SSH tunnel (no login; bind=0.0.0.0 opens it to your network).

entry.title: Keyscope 1.1.2
entry.summary: Listens to any track and names its key, chord, bass note and tuning, from the spectrum of the whole mix; the audio passes through untouched.

entry.title: Chordsmith 1.0.6
entry.summary: Chord tool: pads, keys or chord buttons play scale, set or custom chords with voicing, strum, arp and harp modes, MIDI out to other tracks and a built-in preview synth.

entry.title: Acid 3.0.1
entry.summary: TB-303-style acid bassline sequencer: two blendable lines with generate/mutate, driving a synth track over MIDI, with a touchscreen skin and Q-Links.

entry.title: πClideaN 1.3.7
entry.summary: Sixteen-lane hybrid MIDI sequencer with Euclidean patterns, per-step expression, scales, selective randomization and dual-LFO modulation.

entry.title: Xenia 1.1.0
entry.summary: An emulation of the Microwave XT wavetable synthesizer's original firmware (gearmulator's 68k and DSP56300 emulators) for Gen2 MPC devices, with a PLAY page laid out like the XT's front panel, two skins, ROM banks, a patch browser, named favourites and Q-Link control on every page. Gen2 (aarch64) only; you need your own Microwave XT ROM.

entry.title: Welle 0.3.0
entry.summary: Waldorf Wave emulation running from the original Wave OS - developed by Mookid. Styled faithfully to the original panel. Needs your own Wave OS 1.700 files, uploaded from the Plugin Manager.

entry.title: VHS Vibes 1.5.3
entry.summary: A worn video-tape effect: pitch wobble, tape saturation, generation loss, B-type noise reduction, hum, hiss and crackle, plus deck faults (level control, drift, tracking drop-outs) and a dry/wet mix. 34 programs, on a hot pink cassette with reels that turn.

entry.title: Vavra 1.0.0
entry.summary: An emulation of the Waldorf microQ's original OS (gearmulator) as a native instrument for Gen2 MPC devices, with a native screen in the look of its front panel (three skins), 300 ROM sounds plus your own sound sets, RANDOM, named favourites, Q-Link control and MPC tempo sync. Gen2 (aarch64) only; you need your own microQ ROM.

entry.title: Vavra 0.1.0
entry.summary: An emulation of the Waldorf microQ's original OS (gearmulator) as a native instrument for Gen2 MPC devices, with a native screen in the look of its front panel (three skins), 300 ROM sounds plus your own sound sets, RANDOM, named favourites, Q-Link control and MPC tempo sync. Gen2 (aarch64) only; you need your own microQ ROM.

entry.title: Undertow 1.5.0
entry.summary: Altered stereo delay with Analogue, Tape, Lo-Fi and Reverse modes, degrading repeats, runaway feedback, tempo sync and Tails. Nine presets, sepia touchscreen skin.

entry.title: Tidal Verb 1.6.0
entry.summary: Stereo reverb with ten types, from Room and Hall to a dark swirling Abyss and a cascading-octave shimmer. Decay, Liveliness, Swirl, Warmth and Air controls, eleven presets, deep-sea touchscreen skin.

entry.title: Sysex Bandit 1.0.0
entry.summary: Send and receive MIDI System Exclusive from a track: pick or hand-edit a .syx message, aim it at one output device, listen on one input and save what arrives. Makes no sound.

entry.title: SetBfree Organ 0.4.0
entry.summary: Tonewheel organ with drawbars, selectable generator foldback, percussion, scanner, editable Leslie and keyboard splits.

entry.title: Profit-08 2.0.2
entry.summary: Eight-voice, two-layer analog-style synthesizer: stack and split layers, a gated sequencer and arpeggiator, a resonant 2/4-pole filter, and a banks browser with favourites for your own program and bank SysEx dumps. 2.0 adds a native MPC screen with large knobs and Q-Link control of every page.

entry.title: OxZygen 0.7.6
entry.summary: A dark, cinematic instrument: choirs, sung doos, flutes, reeds, brass, atmospheric strings, bells, Juno-style synths, wind and textures from CC0 recordings, in two layered slots with filter, lo-fi, delay, reverb and sub. 96 presets; a CRT crystal-ball orb reacts as you play. Gen1 (MPC OS 3.x, plus an OS 2.x zip) and Gen2.

entry.title: OsTirusMPC 1.0.0
entry.summary: Virus TI Snow firmware emulation for ARM64 MPC standalone. Eight touch pages, Q-Link maps, USER A-D banks, and direct Single-patch SysEx/MIDI file exchange. Requires the user's own compatible firmware; none is included.

entry.title: OB-Xd MPC 0.4.9
entry.summary: OB-Xd, the Oberheim OB-X emulation: two oscillators with sync and cross-mod, a 12/24 dB filter, voice variation; 128 presets.

entry.title: NodalRed2x 0.1.0
entry.summary: An emulation of the Clavia Nord Lead 2x's original firmware (gearmulator) as a native instrument for Gen2 MPC devices: a native MPC screen laid out like the Nord's panel, a starter bank plus your own sound sets, RANDOM, named favourites in the PRESET menu and Q-Link control. Gen2 (aarch64) only; you need your own Nord Lead 2x ROM.

entry.title: MS2KR 0.1.0
entry.summary: An emulation of the MS2000R analog-modeling synth's own firmware (ms2000r-emu) as a native instrument for Gen2 MPC devices, with a six-page touchscreen skin laid out like the front panel, live LCD, favourites and Q-Link control. Gen2 (aarch64) only; you need your own ROM dumps.

entry.title: Mini-JV 2.0.3
entry.summary: An emulation of the Roland JV-880 sample-based sound engine as a native instrument, with the original reverb and chorus, a Play page with eight macros and a touchscreen skin.

entry.title: M-One 1.3.0
entry.summary: Korg M1-style ROM workstation built on the PicoFaceM1 engine: 100 programs, 100 combinations and the M1's 33 effects from your own M1 ROM set (none included), quick-edit knobs, an FX page for both effects and a Library of SysEx banks with ten original Fullban sounds.

entry.title: JE-8086 1.0.0
entry.summary: An emulation of the Roland JP-8000's original firmware (gearmulator's JE-8086 core) as a native instrument for Gen2 MPC devices, with a touchscreen skin in the JP-8000's look, envelope graphs, named favourites, RANDOM and INIT, tempo sync and Q-Link control. Gen2 (aarch64) only; you need your own JP-8000 ROM.

entry.title: JE-8086 0.1.1
entry.summary: An emulation of the Roland JP-8000's original firmware (gearmulator's JE-8086 core) as a native instrument for Gen2 MPC devices, with a touchscreen skin in the JP-8000's look, envelope graphs, named favourites, RANDOM and INIT, tempo sync and Q-Link control. Gen2 (aarch64) only; you need your own JP-8000 ROM.

entry.title: JC303 0.7.4
entry.summary: 303-style synth for Gen2 MPCs: eight filters, 64-step touch sequencer, modulation matrix, 37 neural drive models and native MPC presets. Hardware tested on Live III.

entry.title: Grainbloom 1.0.0
entry.summary: Granular texture and micro-loop effect. Seven modes (Collage, Cloud, Stutter, Shimmer, Shatter, Arpeggio, Cascade) slice, scatter and pitch the recent past into rhythmic loops or ambient washes, with tempo sync, freeze, feedback and a lush plate/hall reverb. Grain, Scatter, Space and Mix macros on a touch skin.

entry.title: Frodhes 0.9.12
entry.summary: A physically modelled electric piano, vibraphone and marimba, with no samples: 16 voices, 57 presets, drive, chorus, phaser, tremolo, wah, delay, reverb, EQ and a compressor.

entry.title: Dexed 2.0.4
entry.summary: DX7-style 6-operator FM synth (Dexed/MSFA engine) as a native instrument, with .syx bank browsing, all 32 algorithm diagrams and a touchscreen skin with Q-Links.

entry.title: 8Bit Schmitter Studio 1.0.14
entry.summary: CMOS-inspired drone synth with four voices, two six-step sequencers, a modulation matrix and Clouds-derived effects.

entry.title: XXL STRIP MASTER 0.1.1
entry.summary: Master-bus strip in the same console style as XXL STRIP: drive and density, low and high shelving EQ, high-frequency compressor, stereo width and space, transformer stage, high-pass filter, VU meter. By L'Cronx, GPL-3.

entry.title: XXL STRIP BUS 0.1.1
entry.summary: Stereo bus compressor in the style of the classic console bus compressor (G-series style): threshold, ratio, attack, release with auto, make-up, side-chain high-pass, mix, Classic and Modern modes, VU meter. By L'Cronx, GPL-3. Not endorsed by the makers of the original.

entry.title: XXL STRIP 0.1.1
entry.summary: Channel strip in the style of a classic large-format British console (4000 E / G style): input drive, high- and low-pass filters, four-band EQ in three models (E Brown, E Black, G), compressor, gate / expander and a VU meter. 56 presets. By L'Cronx, GPL-3; the E-model filters and EQ are Dusk Audio's. Not endorsed by the makers of the originals.

entry.title: XXL Pro 0.1.0
entry.summary: Fifteen process modules in the style of classic studio gear in one effect, joined on a touch patch bay: six compressors, five EQs with a preamp, two tape machines and two digital reverbs. Patch any module into any other, in series or parallel. 59 presets. By L'Cronx, GPL-3. Not endorsed by the makers of the originals.

entry.summary: Eight stereo tape-performance effects with six procedural noise layers and native chrome controls.
